issue.title: Retire the intentions legacy fallback readers and one-release Headline aliases

task_type_fields.proposal:
Retire the one-release legacy fallback readers that bob-cli-nh (Intentions, summary, and reflection) kept so un-migrated notes still read. Today `src/native/intentions/fields.rs::read` falls back through `src/native/intentions/legacy.rs` (daily `**Headline:**`/`**Reflection**:` preamble via `parse_daily_headline`/`opening_headline`, week `## Intentions`, quarter `## Outcomes`, year `## Theme` + `## Outcomes`, period `## Reflection`, and the Review opener paragraph) whenever a frontmatter field is absent, with `FieldProvenance::Legacy`/`LegacyReview`. The `missing_headline` alias and `**Headline:**` Review-opener acceptance in `bob periods draft` are documented as one-release aliases in docs/periods.md, and the capture-pomodoros JSON still emits the derived `headline` key.

Proposed scope: remove the read-time fallbacks and the one-release aliases, keep (or deliberately retire) the `bob periods migrate` intentions step that still needs the legacy shape parsers, drop the `legacy_period_text` finding or keep it as a pure detector, update docs/periods.md, docs/capture.md, and the CLI/golden tests. Decide the fate of the `headline` JSON key with Bob Mac Capture (it is a contract consumer).

Evidence the precondition holds: bob-cli-nh.8 migrated the live vault on 2026-11-20 (vault commits b52e6eb07 and db9299154) and `bob periods list -p` now reports zero `legacy_period_text` (rechecked by the bob-cli-nh land agent on 2026-11-20: only the pre-existing 2024.md/2025.md `unscaffolded` errors remain).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved plan plan:202611/period_intentions.md lists "Retiring the period callouts and the legacy fallback" under Out of scope and asks the adopt phase to record "retire the legacy fallback readers after one release" as a follow-up: the fallbacks had to ship so hosts and notes could migrate safely, and retiring them before a release has soaked would strand any host or note still on the old shapes. Proposed by bob-cli-nh.8 note #2; triaged by the bob-cli-nh land agent.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-nh's plan deferred retiring the legacy body-shape fallbacks until one release after adoption; the live vault migrated on 2026-11-20, so this records the planned cleanup.
